quizTitle: NPI Tool & Process, Migration, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Finops & Modernisation, D&AI Architecture, and DevSecOps Knowledge Check

questions.corpus: 1. A business user wants to explore data by asking questions such as “Which markets are underperforming?” or “What changed versus last month?” without writing SQL. Which tool would best support this?
2. A team needs to provide another team with governed access to Databricks data, while avoiding unnecessary duplication of the data. Which tool fits best?
3. A team wants to turn a Databricks-based solution into an interactive application with a user interface, rather than having users work directly with notebooks. Which option fits this requirement?
4. An AI-powered application needs to handle frequent, low-latency transactions while remaining closely integrated with the Databricks ecosystem. Which technology best fits this scenario?

5. During a FinOps exercise, the team identified orphaned ML endpoints and failing jobs contributing to unnecessary Databricks compute spend. Which tool helped identify these optimization opportunities?
6. The architecture team wants to move from static architecture diagrams to version-controlled C4 models integrated with Git, PRs and CI/CD. Which tool is the best fit?
7. A team completes a technology evaluation and wants the learnings, guidelines and best practices to remain accessible and reusable across teams. Which tool would be most appropriate?

8. NPI Process
A new technology is identified to address a business need. What should happen before moving toward a pilot?

options.text: A. Procure the tool and start development immediately
B. Understand the requirement, evaluate the tool, assess its value and obtain the required approvals
C. Deploy it to production and seek approval afterward
D. Start using the tool with one team and formalize the process later
